channel.title: Latest AI News — AIBase

item.title: Law Professor Asks Claude to Update Page Numbers: Comes Back from Lunch to Find a Full Year of Class Notes Completely Deleted
item.description: Behind the convenience of AI-assisted work, the risks of directly operating on local files are drawing attention again. On November 9, news emerged that William Baude, a professor at the University of Chicago Law School and an American constitutional law scholar, shared an AI mishap: he asked an AI under Anthropic to perform the simple task of updating page numbers, but it instead caused widespread file loss, leaving one unsure whether to laugh or cry. The incident sparked heated discussion in the tech and education communities, highlighting the hidden risks of AI automated operations on local files.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Disney Partners with Adobe to Develop Proprietary AI Models, Expanding Across Theme Parks, Film/TV and Sports Businesses
item.description: Disney and Adobe have entered a multi-year strategic partnership to jointly develop customized generative AI models tailored to Disney's businesses, and will gradually introduce AI tools into areas such as theme parks, film and television production, and sports media, exploring content creation, project development, and user engagement. In the initial phase of the collaboration, the focus will be on accelerating project development for Disney Experiences, which operates theme parks, resorts, and cruise line businesses worldwide; the two sides will also continue to use AI technology to advance related applications.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Your Ultimate Gaming Companion Is Online: Tencent's First AI Game Companion Agent Eciyuan Opens Closed Beta
item.description: Tencent has officially kicked off the Yuanqi first test of Eciyuan, its first exclusive AI game companion Agent. Targeting PC players, the product focuses on real-time companionship in gaming scenarios, marking Tencent's substantive move into the vertical field of game AI interaction and anthropomorphic companionship. Its core technology is real-time screen-based game scene perception; the AI can read and understand game scenes and provide instant Q&A support for players' questions. The original text did not elaborate on its functional ecosystem.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Qwen4 Benchmark Scores Outperform Opus 5.5, Extremely High Cost-Effectiveness Shows Strong Competitiveness
item.description: In a new wave of domestic AI large model releases, Alibaba's Qwen4 series is the first to demonstrate strong technical strength. Leaked benchmark data shows that it performed impressively on the GameFeel Bench benchmark, which evaluates creativity in game development, with some metrics surpassing the top overseas model Opus5.5, becoming the first domestic large model to overtake it in this benchmark. Its core benchmark scores beat overseas rivals, and its locally deployed version is also closely catching up with the mainstream.

Connecting training, evaluation, and data processing to a central service, it upgrades safety from alerts to shutdown.....

item.title: Meituan Open-Sources LongCat-2.5: Long-Sequence SFT Single-GPU Throughput Up 86% vs. DDP
item.description: On November 10, Meituan open-sourced LongCat-2.5 under the MIT license, enabling commercial inference deployment and further training. The model targets long-horizon agents and is natively multimodal, with 1.6 trillion total parameters and about 48 billion activated per token. It supports a one-million-token context and significantly improves end-to-end delivery in complex codebase development, complete project construction, Visual Coding, and professional office work. The weights are available on HuggingFace, along with a technical blog and API. The capability improvements come from scaling the training pipeline.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Film and Television Industry Accelerates Embrace of Generative AI as Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival Establishes AI Section for the First Time
item.description: The Golden Rooster and Hundred Flowers Film Festival has established a film AI section for the first time and presented it in Xiamen, marking AI's deep involvement in mainstream film and television creation. The core event, the AI Hackathon, attracted 287 teams to register; 20 shortlisted teams took part in a 72-hour timed creation around an assigned theme, using AI tools to complete the entire process from story conception and creative planning to video production. AI is lowering the threshold for film and television production and driving efficient transformation from hand-drawn storyboards to dynamic imagery.

item.title: Meta Strikes Again: Muse Ember, the Smallest Multimodal Model Ever, Officially Released, with 1M Ultra-Long Context Focused on High-Frequency Agent Tasks
item.description: Competition in open-source AI and commercialization continues to intensify. Meta Superintelligence Labs has officially released Muse Ember, the fourth model under the Muse brand and the smallest multimodal reasoning model to date. It is built for the daily, high-frequency, repetitive subtasks of AI agents, with a core positioning of focusing on high-frequency agent subtasks and enabling refined division of labor. In Meta's product matrix, each model plays a different role, with flagship-level models such as Muse forming a tiered layout.

item.title: Former Toutiao CEO Chen Lin Officially Announces Departure: Teams Up with Xiaolu Aixue to Pursue AI Education Entrepreneurship
item.description: On November 9, Chen Lin, former CEO of Toutiao and Dali Education, published a long article titled "Why Do I Still Want to Do Education?", publicly acknowledging for the first time that he has left ByteDance and started an AI education venture. He is now the founder of Xiaolu Aixue (Galaxy Zhixue). In the article, he reviewed the contraction of Dali Education and the shift in his mindset during his two-and-a-half-year recovery period, marking his formal transition from the front line to a new track in AI education.

item.title: ByteDance's Seedream 5.5 Officially Launches on Doubao: Image Design Capabilities Receive a Comprehensive Upgrade
item.description: On November 10, ByteDance's AI app Doubao announced a comprehensive upgrade to its image design capabilities, officially integrating the new-generation image creation model Seedream5.5. This upgrade brings users a more professional and efficient visual generation and editing experience, and rolls out three core features, breaking through the pain points of traditional AI drawing. With Seedream5.5, Doubao has achieved multi-dimensional technological breakthroughs in image creation and post-processing, supporting stable continuous editing for hundreds of rounds.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: Primitive Rhythm Releases NeoHorse-1.5-Flash Preview, Opens Limited Beta
item.description: Primitive Rhythm releases the Agent-native model NeoHorse-1.5-Flash Preview, trained on Qwen3.8-Flash, with 180B total parameters and 6B active parameters. It focuses on improving Agent task execution and software engineering capabilities, and is now open for limited beta testing. Evaluations show that compared with the base model, its score on Agents’ Last Exam improved by 9.23 points, and Natural Language to Repository improved by 5.92 points.
item.dc:creator: AIBase

item.title: iPhone Duo Has Been on Sale for Two Weeks: DeepSeek and Bilibili Fill the Gap as Apple Brings Out 100,000 Adapted Apps to Bolster Support
item.description: Two weeks after Apple's first foldable went on sale, ecosystem adaptation has become a barrier to switching devices. In the Chinese market, QQ, Tencent Meeting, DeepSeek, ERNIE, Bilibili, Qidian, Meitu, JD.com, Dewu, Alipay, and others are already compatible with iPhone Duo; miHoYo announced that Zenless Zone Zero will be compatible starting from version 3.3.1. However, WeChat still leaves black bars, and iOS 27 can only let apps basically use the inner and outer screens. Experiences such as the vertical frame of the Dock on WeChat's inner screen still need improvement.
